items.title_kr: Kohl's, 새로운 Chief Merchandising Officer로 Ryan M. Waymire 임명
items.title_en: Kohl’s Names Ryan M. Waymire Chief Merchandising Officer
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 Ryan M. Waymire를 새로운 Chief Merchandising Officer로 임명하며 merchandise 전략 강화에 나섰습니다. 향후 category별 assortment 개편 및 sourcing 방향에 미칠 영향 모니터링이 필요합니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's has appointed Ryan M. Waymire as Chief Merchandising Officer to strengthen its merchandise strategy. Sales teams should monitor potential impacts on category assortments and sourcing.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, 예상을 상회하는 Q2 EPS 기록 및 full-year outlook 상향 조정
items.title_en: Abercrombie & Fitch Q2 EPS beats at $4.17; raises full-year outlook
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch는 Q2 EPS가 4.17달러를 기록하며 시장 예상을 상회했고, 이에 힘입어 full-year guidance를 상향 조정했습니다. 강력한 brand momentum과 active consumer demand가 실적을 견인하고 있습니다.
items.body_en: Abercrombie & Fitch beat Q2 EPS estimates at $4.17 and raised its full-year guidance. Strong brand momentum and active consumer demand continue to drive performance.

items.title_kr: DoorDash, 학교 개학 시즌 맞아 Kohl's 및 Gap 등 retail 파트너사 배송 서비스 추가
items.title_en: Forgot something for school? DoorDash adds Gap, Barnes & Noble, Carter’s and Kohl’s
items.body_kr: DoorDash가 back-to-school 시즌에 맞춰 Kohl's, Gap, Carter's 등 주요 apparel retail 브랜드를 delivery service에 추가했습니다. E-commerce 및 quick-commerce channel을 통한 실적 연계가 기대됩니다.
items.body_en: DoorDash has added major apparel retailers including Kohl's, Gap, and Carter's to its delivery network for the back-to-school season. This expands quick-commerce channels for these brands.

items.title_kr: Macy's, Thanksgiving Day Parade 100주년 기념 Varsity Jacket 및 exclusive keepsake 출시
items.title_en: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade Varsity Jacket and Rare Photo Book Among 100th Anniversary Keepsakes
items.body_kr: Macy's가 Thanksgiving Day Parade 100주년을 맞아 기념 Varsity Jacket과 photo book 등 exclusive merchandise를 공개했습니다. Holiday season을 앞두고 brand heritage를 활용한 한정판 전략이 돋보입니다.
items.body_en: Macy's has revealed exclusive merchandise including a commemorative Varsity Jacket and photo book for the 100th anniversary of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. This highlights a limited-edition strategy leveraging brand heritage ahead of the holiday season.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, Q2 same-store sales 소폭 하락했으나 관세 환급으로 full-year profit guidance 상향
items.title_en: Kohl's Q2 same-store sales fall 0.9%; tariff refunds drive full-year profit guidance higher
items.body_kr: Kohl's reported a 0.9% drop in Q2 same-store sales, but raised its full-year profit guidance driven by tariff refunds. The company is focusing on defending profitability amidst category slumps.
